canonical_exact_scope: For an actual BinaryNatPopulation, productive pruning retains exactly vertices with infinitely many strict descendants. Finite roots, finite children and strict natural chronology yield an infinite ancestrally closed core, a constructed birth-order reindexing into the original eligible model, preservation of any supplied child cap and equivalence of the full infinite Boolean-word language. Whole-graph IAP is required only for the additional whole-core inspecies/specieslike conclusion; IAP means each member has finitely many descendants or finitely many non-descendants in the stated set. Unrestricted maximal connected-IAP-convex clusters are descendant-closed and pruning commutes; common-ancestor/reflection-constrained maximality need not imply descendant closure, although convexity plus reflection still makes pruning commute. Separately, for any fixed infinite retained S, finite incoming-label deficiency is equivalent to existence of an eligible deletion-only repair on exactly S. Deleting all remaining incoming edges at deficient vertices gives the greatest permissible retained-edge relation and inclusion-smallest deleted-edge/root sets, with all deleted edges below a finite birth bound. The reindexed repair preserves eligibility, a supplied child cap and every avoided target, not full language equivalence. The actual P_s C0 repair disconnects; C1 has the shifted original unlabelled geometry.

theorem core_infinite (E : Graph) (horder : ∀ u v, E u v → u < v)
    (hroots : FiniteSupport (Root E)) (hchildren : ∀ v, FiniteSupport (E v)) :
    InfiniteSupport (Core E)

theorem core_population {E : LabelledGraph} (p : BinaryNatPopulation E) :
    PopulationOn E (Core (ForgetLabels E))

theorem reindexed_core_whole_inspecies {E : LabelledGraph} (p : BinaryNatPopulation E)
    (hiap : IAP (ForgetLabels E) Whole) :
    Inspecies (ForgetLabels (reindexed (core_population p))) Whole

theorem reindexed_core_whole_specieslike {E : LabelledGraph} (p : BinaryNatPopulation E)
    (hiap : IAP (ForgetLabels E) Whole) :
    Specieslike (ForgetLabels (reindexed (core_population p))) Whole

theorem reindexed_core_language_iff {E : LabelledGraph} (p : BinaryNatPopulation E)
    (s : Nat → Bool) : Realizes (reindexed (core_population p)) s ↔ Realizes E s

theorem productive_core_theorem {E : LabelledGraph} (p : BinaryNatPopulation E)
    (hiap : IAP (ForgetLabels E) Whole) (d : Nat)
    (hcap : FixedGenderLift.ChildCap (ForgetLabels E) Whole d) :
    BinaryNatPopulation (reindexed (core_population p)) ∧
    Inspecies (Induced (ForgetLabels E) (Core (ForgetLabels E))) (Core (ForgetLabels E)) ∧
    FixedGenderLift.ChildCap (ForgetLabels (reindexed (core_population p))) Whole d ∧
    ∀ s, ¬ Realizes E s → ¬ Realizes (reindexed (core_population p)) s

theorem maximal_specieslike_descendantClosed (E : Graph) (S : NatSet)
    (horder : ∀ u v, E u v → u < v) (hmax : MaximalSpecieslike E S) :
    DescendantClosed E S

theorem maximal_cluster_pruning_commutes (E : Graph) (S : NatSet)
    (horder : ∀ u v, E u v → u < v) (hmax : MaximalSpecieslike E S) :
    RelativeCore E S = fun v => S v ∧ Core E v

theorem four_axioms_pruning_commutes (E : Graph) (S : NatSet)
    (h : SpeciesRootCriterion.FourAxioms E S) :
    RelativeCore E S = fun v => S v ∧ Core E v

theorem nonmaximal_cluster_productivity_counterexample :
    Specieslike PsEdge (fun v => v = 0) ∧ Core PsEdge 0 ∧
      ¬ RelativeCore PsEdge (fun v => v = 0) 0

theorem constrained_maximum_not_descendantClosed :
    NaturalDateBiosphere ForkEdge ∧
    SpeciesRootCriterion.MaximalFourAxioms ForkEdge OddRay ∧
    Specieslike ForkEdge OddRay ∧ ¬ DescendantClosed ForkEdge OddRay
theorem core_ancestrallyClosed (E : Graph) : AncestrallyClosed E (Core E)

theorem reindexed_population {E : LabelledGraph} {S : NatSet} (p : PopulationOn E S) :
    BinaryNatPopulation (reindexed p)

theorem reindexed_child_cap {E : LabelledGraph} {S : NatSet} (p : PopulationOn E S)
    (d : Nat) (hcap : FixedGenderLift.ChildCap (ForgetLabels E) S d) :
    FixedGenderLift.ChildCap (ForgetLabels (reindexed p)) Whole d

theorem deficient_finite_of_cofinite {E : LabelledGraph} (p : BinaryNatPopulation E)
    (S : NatSet) (hremoved : FiniteSupport (fun v => ¬ S v)) : FiniteSupport (Deficient E S)

theorem cofinite_repair_population {E : LabelledGraph} (p : BinaryNatPopulation E)
    (S : NatSet) (hremoved : FiniteSupport (fun v => ¬ S v)) : PopulationOn (Repair E S) S

theorem finite_deficiency_iff_repair_exists {E : LabelledGraph} (p : BinaryNatPopulation E)
    (S : NatSet) (hinfinite : InfiniteSupport S) :
    FiniteSupport (Deficient E S) ↔
      ∃ F, AdmissibleRepair E S F ∧ PopulationOn F S

theorem repair_greatest (E : LabelledGraph) (S : NatSet) (F : LabelledGraph)
    (hF : AdmissibleRepair E S F) : ∀ u v b, F u v b → Repair E S u v b

theorem repair_minimal_roots (E : LabelledGraph) (S : NatSet) (F : LabelledGraph)
    (hF : AdmissibleRepair E S F) (v : Nat) (hv : S v)
    (hr : Root (ProductiveCore.Induced (ForgetLabels (Repair E S)) S) v) :
    Root (ProductiveCore.Induced (ForgetLabels F) S) v

theorem repair_deleted_edges_bounded {E : LabelledGraph} (p : BinaryNatPopulation E)
    (S : NatSet) (hdeficient : FiniteSupport (Deficient E S)) :
    ∃ bound, ∀ u v b, Restrict E S u v b → ¬ Repair E S u v b →
      u < bound ∧ v < bound

theorem finite_boundary_repair_theorem {E : LabelledGraph} (p : BinaryNatPopulation E)
    (S : NatSet) (hinfinite : InfiniteSupport S) (hdeficient : FiniteSupport (Deficient E S))
    (d : Nat) (hcap : FixedGenderLift.ChildCap (ForgetLabels E) Whole d) :
    let q := repair_population_of_finite_deficiency p S hinfinite hdeficient
    BinaryNatPopulation (reindexed q) ∧
    FixedGenderLift.ChildCap (ForgetLabels (reindexed q)) Whole d ∧
    (∀ s, ¬ Realizes E s → ¬ Realizes (reindexed q) s) ∧
    (∀ i, Root (ForgetLabels (reindexed q)) i ↔ Deficient E S (vertex q i))

theorem ps_c0_repair_roots (s : Nat → Bool) (v : Nat) :
    (SpeciesCones.C0 v ∧ Root (ProductiveCore.Induced
      (ForgetLabels (Repair (BinaryAvoidance.Edge s) SpeciesCones.C0)) SpeciesCones.C0) v) ↔
      v = 0 ∨ v = 2 ∨ v = 3

theorem ps_c1_repair_roots (s : Nat → Bool) (v : Nat) :
    (SpeciesCones.C1 v ∧ Root (ProductiveCore.Induced
      (ForgetLabels (Repair (BinaryAvoidance.Edge s) SpeciesCones.C1)) SpeciesCones.C1) v) ↔
      v = 1 ∨ v = 2

theorem ps_c0_cut_edges (s : Nat → Bool) (u v : Nat) (b : Bool) :
    (Restrict (BinaryAvoidance.Edge s) SpeciesCones.C0 u v b ∧
      ¬ Repair (BinaryAvoidance.Edge s) SpeciesCones.C0 u v b) ↔
    ((u = 0 ∧ v = 2) ∨ (u = 2 ∧ v = 3)) ∧ BinaryAvoidance.Edge s u v b

theorem ps_c1_cut_edges (s : Nat → Bool) (u v : Nat) (b : Bool) :
    (Restrict (BinaryAvoidance.Edge s) SpeciesCones.C1 u v b ∧
      ¬ Repair (BinaryAvoidance.Edge s) SpeciesCones.C1 u v b) ↔
    (u = 1 ∧ v = 2) ∧ BinaryAvoidance.Edge s u v b

theorem ps_c0_repair_not_connected (s : Nat → Bool) :
    ¬ WeaklyConnected (ForgetLabels (Repair (BinaryAvoidance.Edge s) SpeciesCones.C0))
      SpeciesCones.C0

theorem ps_c1_repair_shifted_geometry (s : Nat → Bool) (u v : Nat) :
    ForgetLabels (Repair (BinaryAvoidance.Edge s) SpeciesCones.C1) (u + 1) (v + 1) ↔
      PsEdge u v

clause_map.clause: Actual productive set infinite/ancestrally closed; constructed birth-order reindexing yields original eligible population and preserves supplied child cap
clause_map.premises: Strict natural chronology/finite roots/finite children for infinitude; full original BinaryNatPopulation derives retained PopulationOn. Generic reindexing accepts PopulationOn; core_population discharges it from actual p. No input enumeration or infinite path.

clause_map.clause: Exact FULL infinite Boolean word language of actual reindexed productive core
clause_map.premises: Original BinaryNatPopulation only; no IAP or uniform cap. Every original infinite path vertex productive by chronology; no finite-path preservation.
Whole original graph IAP REQUIRED here, not imposed on plain language/eligibility; IAP per actual member finite descendants OR finite nondescendants.

clause_map.clause: Unrestricted maximal connected IAP convex clusters descendant closed/pruning commutes; constrained common-ancestor/reflection maxima do not imply closure
clause_map.premises: Unrestricted MaximalSpecieslike ranges over weakly connected/IAP/convex supersets under strict natural order. FourAxioms includes CA and Reflection; pruning commutes via convexity/reflection, not false descendant closure. Countercontrol fork is unlabelled NaturalDateBiosphere, NOT asserted binary incoming-label population. Alexander shared-root two-ray example credited.

clause_map.clause: Fixed infinite retained S: finite incoming-label deficiency iff eligible deletion-only repair; greatest edges/smallest deleted-edge and root sets; all deleted retained edges below one finite birth bound
clause_map.premises: No changing S/addition/relabeling. Deficient includes original retained roots (already parentless); lost parent alone insufficient. Canonical Repair retains exactly original S-S edges into nondeficient targets. Cofinite deletion sufficient not necessary.

clause_map.clause: Actual reindexed repair eligibility/cap/avoidance and exact repaired-root correspondence
clause_map.premises: Infinite S, finite actual deficiency and original child cap. Only implication repaired realization -> original; no full-language/connectivity/species preservation.

clause_map.clause: Actual P_s C0/C1 controls including retained roots, removed retained edges, disconnection and shifted geometry
clause_map.premises: C0 roots0,2,3/cuts0->2 and2->3/zeroisolated; C1 roots1,2/cut1->2/shifted unlabelled PsEdge. Original labels retained. These are same-source exact controls, not novelty.
